subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

EZC, IDG, MHK, QLO, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37dcaeaa93c4256ed68c4321a1530a300aa61622f437c3b91372b79307f13b7e.png] 

Logic followed here is:

Each letter in the cluster is increased by 4 in its respective position to obtain the next cluster in the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a250b750eabe838720fa2a0bb769931e003c9ca51a8e7336c014201492de0f02.png] 

 

The pattern observed for each letter is: (Previous letter's positional value) + 4.

Therefore, the letter-cluster that will replace the question mark is **UPS**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
